observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Hisense microwave oven.
The box identifies the model as H20MOWS14.
The box specifies a 20L capacity and 700W power output.
The box features an image of a white microwave with a black glass door and two mechanical knobs.
The actual appliance is not visible in the photo.
There is a watermark 'ZEETECH ELECTRONICS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' on the image.
The box shows some wear and creasing at the corners.

risks.risk: The item inside the box may be missing, a different model, or a different color.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual unit and its rear rating plate.

risks.risk: The unit may have significant cosmetic damage or be heavily used.
risks.proof: Photos of the unit from all sides and the interior.
Video of the unit heating a cup of water.

risks.risk: Essential components like the glass turntable or rotating ring may be missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the interior with the door open.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual microwave oven out of the box.
Photo of the rating plate on the back of the unit to confirm the model.
Photo of the interior showing the turntable and cleanliness.
Video of the unit powered on and heating water.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is visible. Without photos of the actual appliance, its condition and presence cannot be confirmed, making even a worst-case price unreliable.
